title: Kestrel and the Extraction
author: Ines Thackeray
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
